input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) requires Customer to pay open-ended "early termination charges" fixed in Attachment A / Service Option Attachments, with no cap or definition in the Agreement; Section 10 further preserves IBM's recovery of "amounts owing for Services that would have been rendered but for Customer's breach". These are liquidated-type amounts payable by Customer, contrary to the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties, and potentially approaching the remaining contract value (walk-away territory). No service-credit remedy runs in our favour (11.1 imposes only Customer support obligations). Because the early-termination charge is an established commercial term of a facilities services deal, we take the fallback: cap it at three months' recurring Charges and make it the sole liquidated amount on termination.

proposal.summary: Cap Customer-payable early termination charges at three months' recurring Charges and make them the sole liquidated amount.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties should be payable by us, so we have capped the early termination charges referenced to Attachment A at three months' recurring Charges and confirmed they are the sole amount due on a convenience termination. As drafted the charge is open-ended and could exceed the remaining contract value.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' recurring Charges for the terminated Services and will be Customer's sole liability, and IBM's sole and exclusive remedy, in respect of such termination. Customer will not be liable for any liquidated damages, penalty, or unaccrued or future charges in connection with any termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.
